introHtml: Wheat straw cutting boards offer a sustainable alternative to plastic or bamboo, made from agricultural byproducts that would otherwise go to waste. These lightweight, durable boards resist stains and odors, making them ideal for daily use in breakrooms or at catered events. Decorate with your logo via screen printing or laser engraving for a clean, professional look that aligns with your company's green initiatives.
